name: expense-webapp

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Loads and changes expenses, categories, budgets, reports and members; asks for bill upload links.

dependencies.name: bill-reader
dependencies.description: Sends an uploaded bill to the agent and receives the values it read.

description: The single browser app both household members use: the shared expense list with filters and totals, adding, editing and deleting expenses, bill upload with a review step, categories, budgets and the monthly report. It is a separate deployable because it is the only user-facing surface. It holds no data or credentials; the API and the agent do the work.
